name: Kimpton Cottonwood Hotel
insider_take: This boutique gem sits in the heart of Omaha's historic Blackstone District, where restored 1916 architecture meets modern luxury in Nebraska's most vibrant neighborhood.
whats_special: The Kimpton Cottonwood is housed in a beautifully restored early 20th-century building that was once part of Omaha's bustling commercial district. The hotel's design pays homage to the area's rich history while offering contemporary amenities. You're steps away from the iconic Blackstone District, known for its craft cocktail scene, farm-to-table restaurants, and vintage shops that have transformed this area into Omaha's cultural epicenter.
pro_tip: Ask for a room facing Farnam Street to catch glimpses of the district's stunning murals and historic facades. The evening golden hour creates perfect photo opportunities from your window.
dont_miss: Take a short walk to the nearby Joslyn Art Museum, one of the finest art museums in the Midwest, or explore the Henry Doorly Zoo - consistently ranked among the world's best zoos. The Old Market district is just minutes away, offering cobblestone streets, unique galleries, and Omaha's famous steakhouses that put this city on the culinary map.
pros: Prime downtown Omaha location with easy access to attractions
Signature Kimpton boutique style and personalized service
Pet-friendly accommodations with no additional fees
Modern amenities and stylish contemporary design
cons: Urban location may have limited outdoor space
Boutique property with fewer rooms than larger chain hotels
